LanguageData.LC_Bullet_HpHeal_Desc: Fire an HP Recovery Bullet at a target area (radius 3.5), healing up to 20 injury severity on friendly colonists.\n\nCharges remaining: {0}/{1}
LanguageData.LC_Bullet_SpHeal_Desc: Fire an SP Recovery Bullet at a target area (radius 3.5), reducing LC Mental Damage by 50% and calming non-aggressive mental breaks.\n\nCharges remaining: {0}/{1}
LanguageData.LC_Bullet_RedShield_Desc: Deploy a RED damage barrier (absorbs up to 50 RED / physical damage) on friendly colonists in a 3.5-cell radius.\n\nCharges remaining: {0}/{1}
LanguageData.LC_Bullet_WhiteShield_Desc: Deploy a WHITE damage barrier (absorbs up to 50 WHITE / psychic damage) on friendly colonists in a 3.5-cell radius.\n\nCharges remaining: {0}/{1}
LanguageData.LC_Bullet_BlackShield_Desc: Deploy a BLACK damage barrier (absorbs up to 50 BLACK erosion damage) on friendly colonists in a 3.5-cell radius.\n\nCharges remaining: {0}/{1}
LanguageData.LC_Bullet_PaleShield_Desc: Deploy a PALE damage barrier (absorbs up to 50 PALE soul damage) on friendly colonists in a 3.5-cell radius.\n\nCharges remaining: {0}/{1}
LanguageData.LC_Bullet_Slow_Desc: Fire a Welfare Team Slowing Bullet (radius 4.0) that halves the movement speed of hostile entities, abnormalities, and ordeals.\n\nCharges remaining: {0}/{1}
LanguageData.LC_Bullet_Execution_Desc: Fire a Disciplinary Team Execution Bullet to cleanly erase a targeted humanlike pawn without leaving a corpse or triggering death morale penalties.\n\nCharges remaining: {0}/{1}
